description.value: Celista Estate Winery is an 80-acre farm and vineyard on the north shore of Shuswap Lake in BC's interior, producing award-winning wines that have accumulated 115 medals over 14 years at national and international competitions. Visitors can take guided vineyard and winery tours, sample wines in the tasting room, dine at the on-site restaurant, rent one of four lakeside cabins, or attend a summer concert. The property is kid- and pet-friendly and wheelchair accessible, and the vineyard-and-lake panorama makes it a memorable destination stop.
